segments.name: Tulips
segments.description: Produces and sells fresh cut tulips to retail stores in the United States and internationally.
segments.evidence: The Company is the majority owner of Fresh Tulips USA LLC, Bloomia B.V., and its affiliated entities, collectively referred to as "Bloomia." Bloomia is a significant producer of fresh cut tulips ("stems") in the U.S.

revenueModel.text: Retail stores purchase fresh cut tulip stems from Bloomia, with a small number of mass-market retailers accounting for more than seventy-five percent of annual sales.
revenueModel.evidence: A small number of mass-market retailers in the U.S. have historically accounted for more than 75% of Bloomia's total annual sales.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company discontinued development of its non-bank lending business through Farmland Credit, Inc. to focus solely on agriculture.
changes.evidence: the Company has determined to focus solely on the ag business. Because the non-bank lending business remained in development, this change did not have a significant adverse impact on the Company's operations or financial results.
